name: cTSWantDefinition::cTSWantDefinition (both vtables, the strings empty, icon keys {0x856ddbac, 0x499db772, 0, 0}, game version flags 1, multiplier 1)
notes: Hooked (lane IL, adapter: placement new of ours; the only caller is cTSWantTreeManager::CreateInstance#2 0x552370). Difftest WantDefinition_Read (2000 seeds): a definition from the image's operator new (memory 0xcd) and the original constructor against ours (`new` on odd seeds, our adapter on the same kind of memory on even ones); every field compared after construction and after each step. The word at +0x20 is masked to its low half: the constructor's `mov word ptr [esi + 0x20], 0` (0x5b1131) leaves +0x22/+0x23 as the memory was and nothing writes them. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, filter WantDefinition, 42 across the class, plus 2 targeted at the embedded-NUL copy and the held-string count; the final test kills all 42): all killed.

name: cTSWantDefinition::~cTSWantDefinition (destroys the strings)
notes: Covered by WantDefinition_Read (every case releases the definition to destruction; the string-table resources' and property strings' counts compared). In effect through its callers (lane IL): its only caller is Release 0x5b2720, itself reached only through the game vtable 0xdd8548, which only the hooked constructor and this destructor store.

name: cTSWantDefinition::ReadProperties (slot 21: every property the definition knows from a want node's property set, and the stringSet table's entries 1-4 through cTSString)
notes: Difftest WantDefinition_Read (2000 seeds): one or two random property sets per case with random subsets of the 21 names, mostly in the type the read expects, sometimes another; string values from the image's value names, variants (a case flip, an extra letter, an embedded NUL), junk and empty; stringSet values across the range edges; the string-table entries from a fake resource manager (found or not, random texts, bullets) in the group a fake persist system answers. Compared: all fields and strings, the getters, the property strings' counts after the read, the persist system's and resource manager's calls, the resources' Strlen/Data/Release. An unused AnyStringSet local of the original (constructed and destroyed, never read) is left out: it touches only the allocator. In effect through its callers (lane IL): only the game vtable 0xdd8548 refers to it.
